title: Ten oat-bite variations from one binder batch (draft)

shared_batch.instructions: Prepare the declared peanut-butter/syrup binder in one permitted-capacity batch, then portion it before applying the variant additions. The numerical yield is a planning declaration, not a measurement or a heat-process validation.

variants.name: Double Vanilla Cream
variants.instructions: 6 drops Mexican vanilla; 1 tsp Brown sugar

variants.name: Bright Caramel
variants.instructions: 4 drops Mexican vanilla; 2 drops Honey; 2 tsps Brown sugar

variants.name: The Dark Roast
variants.instructions: 6 drops Cold brew extract; 1 tsp Brown sugar

variants.name: The Midnight Mocha
variants.instructions: 6 drops Cold brew extract; 2 drops Syrup; 2 tsps Brown sugar

variants.name: The Affogato
variants.instructions: 4 drops Mexican vanilla; 4 drops Cold brew extract; 1 tsp Brown sugar

variants.name: The Master Blend
variants.instructions: 3 drops Mexican vanilla; 3 drops Honey; 3 drops Cold brew extract; 2 tsps Brown sugar

preparation.review_note: The supplied proposal gives 45 seconds of heating and 8–10 minutes of stacked freezing. Those times, container suitability, shelf life, and the claim of stopped hydration have not been established. Use suitable food-contact equipment and a validated cooling/storage method. A week plan does not imply seven days of refrigerator life. Drops remain dispenser-dependent; no milliliter or mass conversion is assumed.
